title: Sparse coupling yields a particular partition

statements.text: When the dynamics are sparsely coupled, conditional independencies follow in the steady-state density, and these independencies define a particular partition with a Markov blanket.

sources.quote: establishing a particular partition of states based upon conditional independencies that inherit from sparsely coupled dynamics
if the coupling among an ensemble of dynamical systems is mediated by short-range forces, then the states of remote systems must be conditionally independent.
